sloka: अङ्केनादाय वैदेहीं लज्जमानां यशस्विनीम् ।लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा विक्रान्तेन धनुष्मता ।। ६.१२५.१३ ।।
transliteration: aṅkenādāya vaidehīṁ lajjamānāṁ yaśasvinīm ।lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā vikrāntena dhanuṣmatā ।। 6.125.13 ।।

translations.english: After duly honouring all the Vanaras, to Vibheeshana and highly courageous Sugriva, Kakuthsa spoke as follows.
